notes.text:
Released with the record housed in a generic white poly lined inner sleve.

[It says on the back cover:]
"Tracks 3, 6, 7 mixed by [...]." This is obviously wrong since there are only 6 tracks on the EP.

[Text on hype sticker:]
A collection of live performances and alternative takes spanning the band's vast career.
Captured in their home of Niger between 2017-2020.
"This is how rock & roll should sound"
Rolling Stone
Pressed on limited edition green vinyl.

The runouts are etched. "I1" is reverse flip text.
